title: Identify the top 5 play formats with the most banned cards that are also bl
question: Identify the top 5 play formats with the most banned cards that are also black-bordered. For each of these formats, list all distinct banned card names that have a converted mana cost greater than 2.

prediction.sql:
WITH TopFormats AS (
    SELECT l."XCL_084" AS format
    FROM legalities AS l
    INNER JOIN cards AS c ON c."XCL_072" = l."XCL_086"
    WHERE l."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
      AND c."XCL_005" = 'black'
    GROUP BY l."XCL_084"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT DISTINCT l."XCL_084" AS format, c."XCL_049" AS card_name
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c."XCL_072" = l."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN TopFormats AS tf ON l."XCL_084" = tf.format
WHERE l."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
  AND c."XCL_005" = 'black'
  AND c."XCL_011" > 2
